creator.match: Match each detective to the person or team who created them.
creator.reverse: Which of these detectives was created by {value}?

exclude.why: a duo and a book series, not one detective

rows.label: Sherlock Holmes
rows.creator: Arthur Conan Doyle
rows.description: fictional character (consulting detective) created by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
rows.hook: is a consulting detective famed for astonishing observation and deduction, aided by his friend Dr. Watson

rows.label: Hercule Poirot
rows.creator: Agatha Christie
rows.description: fictional Belgian detective by Agatha Christie
rows.hook: is a fastidious Belgian sleuth with a waxed moustache who trusts his little grey cells

rows.label: Mike Hammer
rows.creator: Mickey Spillane
rows.description: fictional private detective created by Mickey Spillane
rows.hook: is a tough, no-nonsense private eye whose bestselling pulp novels sold over a hundred million copies

rows.label: Sam Spade
rows.creator: Dashiell Hammett
rows.hook: is the hard-boiled private eye who chases a priceless statuette in The Maltese Falcon

rows.label: Olivia Benson
rows.creator: Dick Wolf
rows.description: fictional character on the NBC police procedural drama Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
rows.hook: is a New York police captain on a long-running NBC crime drama, played by Mariska Hargitay

rows.label: Miss Marple
rows.creator: Agatha Christie
rows.description: fictional character appearing in Agatha Christie's crime novels
rows.hook: is an elderly spinster from the village of St Mary Mead who solves murders as an amateur sleuth

rows.label: Velma Dinkley
rows.creator: Joe Ruby and Ken Spears
rows.description: fictional character from the Scooby-Doo universe

rows.label: Nancy Drew
rows.creator: Stratemeyer Syndicate
rows.description: fictional character in a juvenile mystery series created by the Stratemeyer Syndicate publisher under the collective pseudonym Carolyn Keene
rows.hook: is a teenage amateur sleuth in a long-running mystery book series published under the pen name Carolyn Keene

rows.label: The Hardy Boys
rows.creator: Stratemeyer Syndicate
rows.hook: are teenage brothers Frank and Joe who solve mysteries in a long-running series of novels for young readers

rows.label: Harry Bosch
rows.creator: Michael Connelly
rows.description: fictional detective created by author Michael Connelly
rows.hook: is an LAPD homicide detective named after a Dutch painter, played on TV by Titus Welliver

rows.label: Philip Marlowe
rows.creator: Raymond Chandler
rows.description: fictional character created by Raymond Chandler
rows.hook: is the wisecracking hard-boiled private eye who first appeared in The Big Sleep

rows.label: Inspector Clouseau
rows.creator: Blake Edwards
rows.hook: is a bumbling, mustached French police detective famously played by Peter Sellers
